title: onReceive中会收到截断的数据
body:
设置了\r\n\r\n为结束符,连续发送100段数据(用fsockopen打开, 然后通过write发送, 循环100次, 最后close), 其中每段数据的最后也用\r\n\r\n作为结束
但是有些时候, 发送的100段数据中,会有1-2段数据出错, 经过日志打印, 发现数据被截断了
中间并没有\r\n\r\n, 但是被拆成了2次onReceive

我自己用日志打印了一下, 发现onReceive的回调函数里面打印的数据, 被拆成了2次

comments.body: 之前没有开启open_eof_split，因为会出错，看到你另外一个回复，关闭了ringbuffer，重新开启了open_eof_split之后，这个问题就没有再复现了~

satisfaction_conditions: A solution that prevents data from being split across multiple onReceive callbacks when using end-of-data markers
Guidance on proper configuration of the open_eof_split option
Information about potential conflicts between ringbuffer and open_eof_split settings

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

dockerfile:
FROM php:5.6-cli

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /usr/src/app

# Update to use archive.debian.org for Debian Stretch packages
RUN sed -i 's/deb.debian.org/archive.debian.org/g' /etc/apt/sources.list \
    && sed -i 's/security.debian.org/archive.debian.org/g' /etc/apt/sources.list \
    && sed -i '/stretch-updates/d' /etc/apt/sources.list

# Install dependencies for building Swoole
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    unzip \
    libssl-dev \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    make \
    autoconf \
    g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the repository at the specific commit related to the issue #464
RUN git clone https://github.com/swoole/swoole-src.git . \
    && git checkout 7c8747fd202d81286171973fdde8c70e19711173

# Build and install Swoole
RUN phpize \
    && ./configure \
    && make -j$(nproc) \
    && make install

# Enable Swoole extension
RUN docker-php-ext-enable swoole

# Create a test script to demonstrate the issue with data truncation in onReceive
RUN echo '<?php\n\
// Server to test the issue with truncated data in onReceive\n\
$server = new swoole_server("0.0.0.0", 9501);\n\
\n\
$server->set([\n\
    "worker_num" => 1,\n\
    "open_eof_check" => true,\n\
    "package_eof" => "\\r\\n\\r\\n",\n\
]);\n\
\n\
$server->on("connect", function ($server, $fd) {\n\
    echo "Client connected: {$fd}\\n";\n\
});\n\
\n\
$server->on("receive", function ($server, $fd, $from_id, $data) {\n\
    echo "Received data length: " . strlen($data) . "\\n";\n\
    echo "Data: " . substr($data, 0, 100) . "...\\n";\n\
    \n\
    // Check if data ends with proper EOF\n\
    if (substr($data, -4) !== "\\r\\n\\r\\n") {\n\
        echo "WARNING: Data does not end with \\r\\n\\r\\n, possible truncation!\\n";\n\
    }\n\
    \n\
    $server->send($fd, "Received: " . strlen($data) . " bytes\\n");\n\
});\n\
\n\
$server->on("close", function ($server, $fd) {\n\
    echo "Client closed: {$fd}\\n";\n\
});\n\
\n\
// Uncomment to run:\n\
// $server->start();\n\
echo "Swoole is installed. You can run the test script to verify the issue #464.\\n";\n\
' > test_issue_464.php

# Create a client script to test the issue
RUN echo '<?php\n\
// Client to test sending multiple data packets\n\
$client = fsockopen("127.0.0.1", 9501, $errno, $errstr, 30);\n\
if (!$client) {\n\
    echo "$errstr ($errno)\\n";\n\
    exit(1);\n\
}\n\
\n\
echo "Connected to server\\n";\n\
\n\
// Send 100 data packets with \\r\\n\\r\\n as EOF\n\
for ($i = 0; $i < 100; $i++) {\n\
    $data = "Data packet #{$i}: " . str_repeat("X", 1024) . "\\r\\n\\r\\n";\n\
    fwrite($client, $data);\n\
    echo "Sent packet {$i}\\n";\n\
    // Small delay to avoid overwhelming the server\n\
    usleep(10000);\n\
}\n\
\n\
fclose($client);\n\
echo "Test completed\\n";\n\
' > test_client_464.php

# Set the default command to check PHP modules
CMD ["php", "-m"]
